description: React component for setting up Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) in Mattermost, including generating QR code and handling user input for MFA code.

classes.name: Setup
classes.description: React component class for MFA setup, managing QR code display and MFA code submission.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Generates MFA secret and QR code on component mount if user is eligible.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles form submission, validates MFA code, and activates MFA.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders MFA setup form with QR code, secret, and input for MFA code.
